text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was completely captivated by the winning Umamusume.
...I was nothing more than a background extra.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"As if I have...
the talent to be a protagonist—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, damn it all! This sucks!
I'm so pathetic for being this clumsy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...! Next time for sure,
I'm gonna create an awesome masterpiece~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer! Next time for sure,
I'll move everyone's hearts with my running!

Thank you!
...I might be on a losing streak right now, but I'll make sure to leave behind a true masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I am Kiseki! A creator who weaves
the greatest stories of all!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely!
Pulling off a huge comeback is the real thrill of racing!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the classic, royal road
that makes everyone's hearts tremble with excitement!
